question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d0505d307612d6cf1dce5e97401a8ced54be79a5519712f21135f64c8fc7df.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First letter + 2 = Second Letter and Second and Third letters are coded according to the equivalent opposite letter of a particular letter of the word.

 
• QSH → Q + 2 = S; S ↔ H
 
• **MPI → M + 3 = P; P ↔ K ≠** I
 
• KMN → K + 2 = M; M ↔ N
 
• CEV → C + 2 = E; E ↔ V

Hence, '**MPI**' is the odd one out.
